---> Blocks 12 to 18 are NOT all clear.I was not able to extract the exact reproducer yet, but I think I narrowed the miscompilation down to

    void ext2fs_fast_clear_bit_(unsigned int nr, void * addr)
    {
        unsigned char   *ADDR = (unsigned char *) addr;

        ADDR += nr >> 3;
        *ADDR &= (unsigned char) ~(1 << (nr & 0x07));
    }
